name: K
bio: Koga Yudai (古賀 祐大; born October 21, 1997), known professionally as K (ケイ; 케이), is a Japanese singer and choreographer under HYBE Labels Japan. He is a member of the boy group &TEAM.

credits.title: HYBE CHEERING PARTY
credits.overview: The heat of cheering for HYBE artists unfolds in cinemas! Sing along with your favorite HYBE Artists in 3D! A one-of-a-kind game-like cheering screening is coming, where fans can chant fan cheers and wave their light sticks while watching the music videos of BTS, SEVENTEEN, TOMORROW X TOGETHER, ENHYPEN, LE SSERAFIM, &T

credits.title: Blue Lock
credits.overview: After years of defeat, Japan's Football Union gathers 300 high school players in a ruthless training program to find the world's greatest striker, where failure means permanent exclusion from the national team.

credits.title: 2026 &TEAM CONCERT TOUR 'BLAZE THE WAY' in JAPAN
credits.overview: The LaLa arena TOKYO-BAY performances of 2026 &TEAM CONCERT TOUR ‘BLAZE THE WAY’ in JAPAN will be broadcast live to movie theaters on Sunday, July 26. Enjoy the event together on the big screen with an immersive cinema experience!

credits.title: Ya Boy Kongming! The Movie
credits.overview: The greatest music battle festival in history, Music Battle Awards 2025! Kongming and Eiko take on the challenge!  Furthermore, the descendant of Sima Yi, Sima Jun, stands before them as a young strategist!!

credits.title: HYBE CINEMA NORAEBANG
credits.overview: Experience South Korea’s iconic NORAEBANG culture in cinemas! Unleash your inner pop star and belt out your favorite HYBE hits from BTS, SEVENTEEN, TOMORROW X TOGETHER, ENHYPEN, LE SSERAFIM, &TEAM, BOYNEXTDOOR, TWS, ILLIT and KATSEYE like never before at this singalong event in cinemas!
